title: The Stanley Parable (2013)
blockers: Steam 2013 edition only; excludes Ultra Deluxe and Epic. Male subtitle variant selected; upstream also offers female variant.
Upstream documents Windows and PlayOnMac, not native macOS. No native macOS rendering verification.
Windows native install/uninstall and gameplay validation have not run. macOS package is not built or verified. Original supported game version hashes must be established before release.

installation.backup: Only existing paths enumerated in patch.windows.candidate.json; preserve original bytes and metadata in installation journal.
installation.uninstall: Kitor journal restores changed originals and removes only patch-created files; unrelated game files and saves remain untouched.

platforms.windows: staged copy-data plan, not native validated

target_architectures: Payload data is architecture-independent; native game/runtime compatibility remains unverified.
